title: 36.2s Recording (Jun 15 @ 6:33 PM)
style: Reggaeton and Latin Urban track at 90 BPM in G minor. The arrangement features a classic dembow rhythm with a heavy, rounded kick drum and a crisp, dry snare. A syncopated, plucked synth bassline follows the kick pattern. A repetitive, high-pitched staccato synth lead provides a melodic hook. Male vocals are delivered in a rhythmic, melodic rap style with light pitch correction and short delay effects. The mix is centered on the low-end punch of the percussion and bass.
